text_block_list.text:
The Summer Training Camp finally begins 
today. Our days of special training with 
our sights set on the Tenno Sho (Autumn) 
begin!

The scouting is done, and the special 
training menu put together for this day is 
all set.

Admire Vega has started looking forward 
and running again. I'll do everything I 
can to support her growth so she can reach 
what she's reaching for...!
choice_data_list: Shall we get right to it?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Why is your face a little red?
choice_data_list:
Ah, well, I was running around a bit, 
so...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Hydration. Loosen the collar. The shade is 
over there.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Training starts in 20 minutes. Is that 
okay with you?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
If you're passed out on the ground, you 
can't exactly 'follow on your own,' can 
you?

"...She has always strived to be an 'older 
sister,' and by nature, she seems 
remarkably caring."

Belatedly coming to realize this, I 
hurriedly made my way to the shade as 
instructed.
